invite.subject: They say I took it
invite.body:
{handle},

You do not know me. A porter I used to work with says you can look at things other people cannot.

I was sacked last week for money I did not take. I cannot pay much, but I can pay. There is a job on the board with my name on it.

Inês Carvalho

invite.subject: Room 412
invite.body:
{handle}, thank you. I read it four times after you did.

I know where the money went. I need one more thing to prove it. It is on the board.

Inês

invite.subject: The first of the month
invite.body:
{handle}, the accountants come in a few days. I have thought about what to do with what you found, and it is one small change. On the board.

Inês

invite.subject: A scheduling matter
invite.body:
{handle},

I am a producer at a small broadcaster a long way north. A film of mine was pulled three hours before it aired and nobody will tell me why.

I am told you find things out. There is a job on the board.

Jonas Hale

invite.subject: The only copy
invite.body:
{handle}, so now I know. Knowing is not enough. I need the film itself, and I can no longer get to it. On the board.

Jonas

invite.subject: One small file
invite.body:
{handle}, I have watched it again. It is good. It should be seen. There is one thing in the way. On the board.

Jonas

invite.subject: Thursday, nine o'clock
invite.body:
{handle}, this is the one that will get me sacked, so I have made sure it pays you properly. On the board.

Jonas

invite.subject: A result I did not sign
invite.body:
{handle},

I am a laboratory technician. I do not know how to write a letter like this, so I will just say it: a result of mine was changed, and what it was a result for matters.

There is a job on the board. Please look at it.

Tomasz Bryl

invite.subject: There is another record
invite.body:
{handle}, thank you. I have not slept much. There is a second file they have forgotten about. On the board.

Tomasz

invite.subject: April
invite.body:
{handle}, I know what to do with it now. One change, and then the right person asks the right question. On the board.

Tomasz

invite.subject: Four hundred pounds
invite.body:
{handle},

I run a small roofing firm. I have just lost a council contract in a way I do not believe, and the council has stopped answering my letters.

A friend said somebody like you might get an answer. There is a job on the board.

Asha Rennick

invite.subject: The bids
invite.body:
{handle}, I had to read that twice. I want to see the bids with my own eyes. On the board.

Asha

invite.subject: A common name
invite.body:
{handle}, look at who won. It may be nothing. I do not think it is nothing. On the board.

Asha

invite.subject: Before Thursday
invite.body:
{handle}, there is a way to stop it without anybody standing up in a meeting. On the board.

Asha

invite.subject: A painting I know
invite.body:
{handle},

I teach school in Aarhus and I have never done anything like this. A painting that belonged to my family is about to be sold as something it is not.

I have some savings. There is a job on the board.

Henrik Aalto

invite.subject: They know
invite.body:
{handle}, they know and they are selling it anyway. I want a name. On the board.

Henrik

invite.subject: The paint
invite.body:
{handle}, a name is not proof. Paint is proof. On the board.

Henrik

invite.subject: Saturday
invite.body:
{handle}, the sale is on Saturday. I need it stopped before then, and I think you can stop it with one word. On the board.

Henrik

invite.subject: There was no power fault
invite.body:
{handle},

I work nights on a container quay. Something happened on my shift in April and I have been told three different stories about it since.

I was given your name by a forwarder in Antwerp. There is a job on the board.

Nadia Ferreira

invite.subject: Somebody was paid
invite.body:
{handle}, so it was done on purpose. Then somebody gained by it. On the board.

Nadia

invite.subject: A second set of orders
invite.body:
{handle}, I think I know what they did, and I hope I am wrong. On the board.

Nadia

invite.subject: The people with lawyers
invite.body:
{handle}, I was not wrong. I cannot take this to anyone here. But I know who would want it. On the board.

Nadia

invite.subject: From someone who used to keep the door
invite.body:
{handle},

I ran night shifts at a security firm you will have heard of. I was let go for asking about something I saw on a console.

You are the sort of person we were paid to keep out, which is why I am writing to you. There is a job on the board.

Brigid Nolan

invite.subject: The file itself
invite.body:
{handle}, a list of dates is a start. I need what was sent. On the board.

Brigid

invite.subject: The client's side
invite.body:
{handle}, now I want to see what it looks like from where the clients sit. On the board.

Brigid

invite.subject: Tomorrow's status page
invite.body:
{handle}, I have written something. It needs putting where fourteen people will read it over breakfast. On the board.

Brigid

invite.subject: A matter of valuation
invite.body:
{handle},

Your name was given to me as someone thorough. I represent parties who are owed money by a number of failing businesses, and I need certain documents before they are lost.

The work is regular and the pay is prompt. The first is on the board.

Silas Marr

invite.subject: A second address
invite.body:
{handle}, satisfactory. The same buyer appears elsewhere. On the board.

S. Marr

invite.subject: A small correction
invite.body:
{handle}, this next one is a change, not a copy. I will explain when it is done. Or I will not. On the board.

S. Marr

invite.subject: The last of it
invite.body:
{handle}, one more, and I owe you some candour with it. On the board.

S. Marr
